steps.title: Thinking like a clinician
steps.body: Today we will practise gathering evidence, recognising uncertainty, and choosing a next step.

steps.title: Pause. Gather. Reassess.
steps.body: Use the history and examination to build a working explanation. Revisit it as new information arrives.

steps.prompt: What makes a useful working diagnosis?

options.text: It can be revised with new evidence

steps.explanation: A working diagnosis is provisional and should adapt to evidence.
Actively considering alternatives can expose assumptions.

options.text: Explain what is known and what needs checking

steps.explanation: Clear communication includes the limits of current knowledge.

steps.title: Keep asking good questions
steps.body: Reflect on one assumption you would check in your next case.
